home.title: MyRecipeWatch Home
home.heading: DietWise: MyRecipeWatch
home.paragraph1: MyRecipeWatch is your ultimate companion for discovering, sharing, and enjoying delicious recipes. Our AI-powered app is designed to help you make informed food choices, reduce food waste, and explore new culinary horizons, all while aligning with national nutrition guidelines.

registration.step1: Open the application menu, click "Login" or press the "Login / Register" button below
registration.step2: In the new login form that appears, click "Register" at the bottom
registration.step3: Enter your email and password (required), name (optional)

recipe.title: MyRecipeWatch Recipe
recipe.welcomeHeading: Welcome to the Recipe assessment page
recipe.welcomeFooter: Don't worry if you forget these instructions; to see them again, press the Help button that will appear at the top of the screen while assessing a recipe!
recipe.enterUrl: Tap to enter the address of the page containing the recipe you want to assess
recipe.emptySuggestionsFromServer: There are no suggestions for this recipe.

help.paragraph1: Click in the area at the top of the page and enter the web address of the page containing the recipe you are interested in assessing. Then click the "Assess" button. The system will begin assessing the recipe.
help.paragraph2: The assessment takes place in two steps: (1) extract the recipe from the page and (2) suggest alternative, healthier and/or more sustainable ingredients. The application displays the list of ingredients in the top half of the page and the suggestions in the bottom half.
help.paragraph3: When browsing suggestions, you have three options:
help.paragraph4: Press an activated button ("Accept" or "Reject") again to switch a suggestion to undecided.
help.paragraph5: Another way to switch a suggestion to undecided is to click the "minus" button of a replaced ingredient in the recipe in the top half of the page.
help.paragraph6: The application displays a rough cost estimation of each alternative in the form of one, two or three Euro symbols (€/€€/€€€), meaning "relatively cheap", "medium/average cost", and "relatively high cost" respectively.
help.rating: The star rating (1-10) reflects how well a recipe aligns with established dietary guidelines. A higher score means the overall balance of ingredients is more in line with recommended nutritional standards. Our AI's suggestions are designed to help you tweak your recipes to achieve a higher rating and improve the overall nutritional balance of your meal.

interventions.4: We’re here to empower you - try this simple swap and see the impact yourself!
interventions.5: You might feel hesitant to replace familiar ingredients. But you might like it.

personalization.title: Personal Information
personalization.intro: All fields are optional. Filling them in lets the app tailor recommendations to nutritional guidelines that fit your profile. See how we handle your data: <policyLink>Privacy Policy</policyLink>.

personalization.yearOfBirthIsNotInThePast: The Year of birth must be in the past

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the MyRecipeWatch mobile application ("the App"), developed by the Institute of Communication and Computer Systems (ICCS) as part of the EU-funded DietWise project. By installing, accessing, or using the App, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

service.heading: 2. About the Service
service.body: MyRecipeWatch is a research application that evaluates online recipes against national nutritional guidelines and proposes alternative ingredients. Suggestions are generated by automated systems and are informational only. The App is provided as part of an ongoing research project and its features may change, be paused, or be discontinued without notice.

eligibility.heading: 3. Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old, or have the consent of a parent or legal guardian, to use the App.

account.heading: 4. Account Registration
account.body: Certain features require an account, authenticated via the DietWise identity service. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify the project team promptly of any suspected unauthorized use.

acceptableUse.heading: 5. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree to use the App only for personal, non-commercial purposes and in compliance with applicable law. You must not: (a) attempt to disrupt or compromise the security of the App or its backend services; (b) use the App to harvest, mine, or otherwise extract data at scale; (c) misrepresent your identity; or (d) submit content that is unlawful, offensive, or infringes the rights of others.

userContent.heading: 6. User-Provided Content and Feedback
userContent.body: When you submit recipe URLs, personal information, or feedback (such as acceptance or rejection of suggestions), you grant the project a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use this data — in anonymized or aggregated form where applicable — for the purposes of operating, evaluating, and improving the service and for research outputs related to the DietWise project. You retain ownership of any content you submit.

recommendationsDisclaimer.heading: 7. Nutritional Recommendations Disclaimer
recommendationsDisclaimer.body: The App's suggestions are generated by automated systems and are intended for general informational purposes only. They are not medical, dietary, or nutritional advice and are not a substitute for professional consultation. Consult a qualified healthcare provider before making significant changes to your diet, especially if you have a medical condition, allergies, or dietary restrictions.
